name: auto-transliteration
description: Auto Transliteration — mobile-first speech translation web app (Azure STT → Google Translation NMT → Google TTS)

scripts._comment:dev:server: PORT is pinned here on purpose: dev tooling often exports PORT for the web app (5173), and the API must not inherit it. Deployments still set PORT normally.
scripts.dev:server: cross-env PORT=8787 npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.dev:client: cross-env PORT=5173 npm run dev --workspace client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace server && npm run test:unit --workspace client
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration --workspace server && npm run test:integration --workspace client
scripts.test:ab: npm run test:ab --workspace server && npm run test:ab --workspace client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace server && npm run test:coverage --workspace client
